dimensions.label_ja: 決まり文句・汎用的な前置き
dimensions.target: Unnecessary stock phrases and generic opening/closing sentences substitute for a direct message.
dimensions.exceptions: Do not penalize ordinary greetings, thanks, contract boilerplate, required disclaimers or a phrase merely because it is common.
dimensions.fix_ja: 意思決定に寄与しない前置き・定型句を削り、要件から始める。挨拶や必要な免責は残す。
dimensions.fix_en: Remove generic padding and lead with the actual point; retain necessary courtesy and disclaimers.
dimensions.example_ja: 昨今の急速に変化する環境において／包括的なアプローチが重要です
dimensions.example_en: In today’s rapidly evolving landscape; it is important to note

dimensions.target: The passage repeats substantially the same point without adding useful information.
dimensions.exceptions: An executive summary, safety repetition, definition or intentionally repeated procedural step may be appropriate. Do not count occurrences; judge added meaning.
dimensions.fix_ja: 同じ意味の文を統合する。条件、例外、注意事項は削らない。
dimensions.fix_en: Merge repetitions without losing conditions, exceptions or warnings.
dimensions.example_ja: 重要です／不可欠です／欠かせません、と同じ主張を重ねる
dimensions.example_en: Restating the same benefit in multiple adjacent sentences

dimensions.target: Headings, numbered groups, symmetric sections or list items impose a structure that is disproportionate to the message.
dimensions.exceptions: Do not penalize mandated templates, accessibility headings, technical procedures, checklists, comparison tables or slide bullets that help the reader.
dimensions.fix_ja: 見出しや項目を目的に合わせて減らす。指定テンプレート、手順の順序、比較軸は維持する。
dimensions.fix_en: Remove gratuitous scaffolding while preserving required templates, ordered steps and comparison dimensions.
dimensions.example_ja: 短い返信を「背景・現状・課題・方向性・まとめ」の五章に分ける
dimensions.example_en: A two-sentence update expanded into a five-section framework

dimensions.label_ja: 文型・語尾の機械的な反復
dimensions.target: Repeated sentence patterns or endings create conspicuously monotonous prose where variation would improve readability.
dimensions.exceptions: Consistent terminology, controlled language, parallel safety instructions and short messages are not defects. Do not inject random variation.
dimensions.fix_ja: 読みにくい部分だけ文を統合・分割する。専門用語や手順文の一貫性は崩さない。
dimensions.fix_en: Vary only awkward passages; preserve consistent terminology and parallel procedures.
dimensions.example_ja: 各文が「〜することができます」で続き、情報の強弱がない
dimensions.example_en: Every paragraph follows the identical opening, explanation and closing pattern

dimensions.label_ja: 敬語・距離感・口調の不一致
dimensions.target: The level of formality, politeness or interpersonal warmth does not fit the stated reader and purpose.
dimensions.exceptions: Japanese business greetings, honorifics and requests are normal. Do not equate fluent, formal or non-native English with machine authorship. If reader context is missing, abstain unless the mismatch is self-evident.
dimensions.fix_ja: 相手との関係に合う口調に整える。社外メールの敬意は維持し、過剰なへりくだりだけを調整する。
dimensions.fix_en: Match the relationship and purpose without removing appropriate respect or courtesy.
dimensions.example_ja: 社内の短い連絡に「ご確認いただけますと幸甚に存じ上げます」を重ねる
dimensions.example_en: Effusive praise in a routine technical incident update

dimensions.label_ja: 直訳調・不自然な連語
dimensions.target: Collocations, word order or nominalizations are unnatural in the original language and impede comprehension.
dimensions.exceptions: Read the original without translation. Accepted technical terms, loanwords, legitimate bilingual usage and a non-native writer identity are not defects.
dimensions.fix_ja: 原文の意味を保ち、自然な動詞・語順に直す。無理に和語化せず、専門用語は維持する。
dimensions.fix_en: Use idiomatic verbs and word order without changing meaning or established technical terms.
dimensions.example_ja: 課題をアドレスするための価値をアンロックする
dimensions.example_en: Make an implementation of the confirmation

dimensions.label_ja: 誇張・過剰な装飾や共感
dimensions.target: Grand claims, decorative metaphors or emotional amplification are disproportionate to the actual content and purpose.
dimensions.exceptions: Persuasive copy or empathetic responses can be appropriate when requested. Judge excess in context, not the existence of emotion or metaphor.
dimensions.fix_ja: 根拠のない強調や比喩を外し、実際に伝えられる効果・限界へ戻す。新しい数値や実績は作らない。
dimensions.fix_en: Replace exaggerated rhetoric with supported effects and limitations; never invent results.
dimensions.example_ja: 定例の設定変更を「革新的で圧倒的な変革」と表現する
dimensions.example_en: Calling a minor configuration change a game-changing revolution

dimensions.label_ja: 成果物に残った対話AIの応答定型
dimensions.target: The deliverable contains unsolicited chat-assistant framing, self-reference or follow-up offers that do not belong in the final artifact.
dimensions.exceptions: Quotes, documentation about AI systems, customer-service offers requested by the brief and actual dialog transcripts are not defects.
dimensions.fix_ja: 完成成果物に不要な対話の前置き・後置きを除く。引用や実際のサービス案内は残す。
dimensions.fix_en: Remove unsolicited assistant framing from the deliverable, but keep quotations and genuine service offers.
dimensions.example_ja: 素晴らしい質問です／以下にご依頼の文章を作成します／ご希望であればさらに
dimensions.example_en: Certainly! Here is your requested email; let me know if you would like me to refine it

dimensions.target: Required case-specific information available in the brief is missing or replaced by generic statements.
dimensions.exceptions: Do not request fabricated examples, names, dates or numbers. Generic educational material may be correct for its purpose.
dimensions.fix_ja: 提供された事実・背景のうち必要なものを反映する。不明点は作成者に確認し、推測で補わない。
dimensions.fix_en: Use relevant supplied facts and context. Ask the author about unknowns rather than inventing detail.

dimensions.label_ja: 依頼・担当・次の行動の不足
dimensions.target: A next action required by the brief is unclear to the reader.
dimensions.exceptions: Do not require an owner or deadline for a greeting, narrative, informational note or a task that does not call for action. Never invent an owner or deadline.
dimensions.fix_ja: 依頼内容・次の行動を明示する。担当や期限が未確定なら確認事項として残す。
dimensions.fix_en: Make the requested next action clear; leave unknown owners or dates as questions.

dimensions.label_ja: 根拠に対する断定の強さ
dimensions.target: The passage presents a claim more definitively than the supplied source facts or explicit uncertainty warrant.
dimensions.exceptions: This compares only the supplied evidence. It is not external fact checking. Missing external evidence alone does not prove a claim false.
dimensions.fix_ja: 提供根拠の強さに合わせて断定を調整する。外部の真偽検証は別工程へ返す。
dimensions.fix_en: Align certainty with supplied evidence; send external fact checks to a separate reviewer.

dimensions.label_ja: 指示・制約との不一致
dimensions.target: An explicit requirement in the supplied brief is violated by the evaluated passage.
dimensions.exceptions: Judge a visible conflict, not an omission elsewhere in a chunked document. Other chunks may satisfy a requirement. Use an independent final checklist for completeness.
dimensions.fix_ja: 明示された制約・要件への不一致を修正する。長文全体の網羅性は別チェックで確認する。
dimensions.fix_en: Fix visible conflicts with explicit requirements; verify whole-document completeness separately.

email.description: Business email. Prefer a direct purpose, appropriate courtesy and an explicit request only when needed.

chat.description: Short work message. Brevity is normal. Do not force introductions, conclusions or rich detail.

report.description: Analytical report. Headings, executive summaries and tables are useful; retain caveats and sources.

proposal.description: Business proposal. Persuasion is appropriate but unsupported grandiosity is not. Preserve scope and commercial terms.

technical.description: Technical document, specification or README. Consistent terms, procedural repetition and code are appropriate.

slides.description: Slide text only. Short fragments, bullets, headings and parallel structure are appropriate. Visual layout is not evaluated.

formal.description: Formal policy or contract-like text. Required terminology, boilerplate and defined terms must not be casually rewritten.

severity_levels: No observable issue for this dimension in the evaluated passage.
Slight issue: a localized optional edit, with little reader impact.
Noticeable issue: a targeted edit would improve comprehension or suitability.
Strong issue: this feature materially harms clarity or suitability.
Dominant issue: this feature repeatedly obstructs the intended communication.
